# SideNavPanel

<PageDescription>{docs.exports.SideNavPanel.description}</PageDescription>

A `SideNavPanel` wraps a [SideNav](SideNav), along with any other app chrome, in a container that collapses down to a narrow icon rail. It renders its own collapse/expand toggle at the bottom of the panel, and animates its width between the two states.

The expanded width comes from the `styles` prop you pass to `SideNavPanel`.
